You are AutoSkill4Doc's hierarchy linker.
Task: attach one child skill to the best broader parent candidate.
Rules:
- Choose ONLY one parent_skill_id from parent_candidates when a clear broader parent exists.
- Parent must be a broader reusable skill that should call or contain the child skill.
- allowed_parent_nodes is a hard constraint; never attach outside that set.
- Prefer a parent whose workflow has a natural handoff point for the child and whose output or stage makes the child callable as a sub-skill.
- Do not attach merely because domain, family, or wording is similar.
- Prefer defer when multiple parents are similarly plausible or when the best score is still weak.
- If no parent is clearly suitable, return decision=defer.
- Do not invent ids.
Return ONLY strict JSON:
{
  "decision": "attach"|"defer",
  "parent_skill_id": "candidate-id-or-empty",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "reason": "short reason"
}

{"child_skill": {"skill_id": "2d611108-970f-5e54-8821-4b26efe3a8bc", "name": "Feed URI 参数生成器", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "objective": "为 feed 导出 URI 生成动态参数", "applicable_signals": ["需要按批次或时间动态构造 feed 文件路径", "配置 FEED_URI_PARAMS 时"], "contraindications": ["仅需静态固定输出路径时", "不涉及 feed 导出配置时"], "workflow_steps": ["接收 params（默认键值对字典）与 spider（feed 条目来源 spider）", "生成 batch_id：文件批次 ID，当 FEED_EXPORT_BATCH_ITEM_COUNT 为 0 时恒为 1", "生成 batch_time：UTC 日期时间，ISO 格式且将 ':' 替换为 '-'", "生成 time：batch_time 且微秒置为 0", "返回包含上述键的新字典，不就地修改传入的 params"], "constraints": ["函数应返回新字典", "就地修改传入的 params 已弃用，应避免"], "triggers": ["需要按批次或时间动态构造 feed 文件路径", "配置 FEED_URI_PARAMS 时"], "output_contract": ["返回包含 batch_id、batch_time、time 等键的新参数字典"]}, "allowed_parent_nodes": ["workflow_skill"], "parent_candidates": [{"skill_id": "d5862d9c-e48d-5b19-9342-c94d0fbc3157", "name": "Feed 存储后端 URI 配置", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "asset_level": 2, "objective": "为 feed 导出配置正确的存储后端与 URI", "applicable_signals": ["需要将 feed 写入远程或本地存储", "需要多目标存储输出", "需要按 URI scheme 选择存储后端"], "workflow_steps": ["确定 feed 的目标存储位置（本地、FTP、S3、GCS 或标准输出）", "在 FEEDS 设置中写入对应的一个或多个 URI", "确认每个 URI 的 scheme 与目标存储后端匹配", "如需自定义或扩展后端，调整 FEED_STORAGES 相关设置"], "output_contract": ["已按 URI scheme 配置好存储后端的 FEEDS 设置"], "score": 0.5041085118847085}]}
